_comment: Small combinatorial data for the dimension-27 kissing configuration.
Derived from the coordinate files; scripts/verify_paper_claims.py checks
it and rebuilds data/dimension27_200540.txt from it.
Ring elements are [a,b,c,d] meaning a + b*sqrt2 + c*sqrt3 + d*sqrt6.
Leech vectors are integer 24-vectors of squared norm 32.

scaling.cap_row: (3y, t) with y.y=32, t.t=144, row norm 432
